017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.staticfile;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.io.*;
022import java.util.*;
023import java.util.concurrent.*;
024
025import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.*;
026
027/**
028 * Resolves a WebJar file to a cache-busted URL under the {@link WebJarsMixin} mount.
029 *
030 * <p>
031 * An asset is named {@code groupId:artifactId:path} (see {@link #asset(String, String, String)}).  The path is
032 * relative to {@code META-INF/resources/webjars/} and may contain {@link #VERSION_TOKEN}, which is replaced with the
033 * version read from the WebJar's own {@code META-INF/maven/<groupId>/<artifactId>/pom.properties}.  The URL gets a
034 * {@code ?v=<version>} cache-buster, so a version bump in the app's pom changes every URL.
035 *
036 * <p>
037 * A missing WebJar, or a missing file in a present WebJar, throws {@link IllegalStateException}, so a page never
038 * renders a tag that would 404.  Versions and file checks are cached for the life of the class loader.
039 *
040 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
041 * <p class='bjava'>
042 *    String <jv>asset</jv> = WebJarResolver.<jsm>asset</jsm>(<js>"org.webjars"</js>, <js>"jquery"</js>, <js>"jquery/{version}/jquery.min.js"</js>);
043 *    String <jv>url</jv> = WebJarResolver.<jsm>resolve</jsm>(<jv>req</jv>, <jv>asset</jv>);  <jc>// .../webjars/jquery/3.7.1/jquery.min.js?v=3.7.1</jc>
044 * </p>
045 *
046 * @since 10.0.0
047 */
048public final class WebJarResolver {
049
050   /** Classpath root of every WebJar's files. */
051   public static final String WEBJARS_ROOT = "META-INF/resources/webjars/";
052
053   /** Placeholder in an asset path that is replaced with the WebJar's version. */
054   public static final String VERSION_TOKEN = "{version}";
055
056   private static final ClassLoader LOADER = WebJarResolver.class.getClassLoader();
057   private static final Map<String,String> VERSIONS = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
058   private static final Map<String,Boolean> PRESENT = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
059
060   private WebJarResolver() {}
061
062   /**
063    * Builds an asset id.
064    *
065    * @param groupId The WebJar group id, e.g. {@code org.webjars}.
066    * @param artifactId The WebJar artifact id, e.g. {@code jquery}.
067    * @param path The file path under {@code META-INF/resources/webjars/}, optionally containing {@link #VERSION_TOKEN}.
068    * @return The asset id {@code groupId:artifactId:path}.
069    */
070   public static String asset(String groupId, String artifactId, String path) {
071      return groupId + ":" + artifactId + ":" + path;
072   }
073
074   /**
075    * Returns the version of a WebJar on the classpath.
076    *
077    * @param groupId The WebJar group id.
078    * @param artifactId The WebJar artifact id.
079    * @return The version from the WebJar's {@code pom.properties}.
080    * @throws IllegalStateException If the WebJar isn't on the classpath or names no version.
081    */
082   public static String version(String groupId, String artifactId) {
083      var key = groupId + ":" + artifactId;
084      var v = VERSIONS.get(key);
085      if (v == null) {
086         v = readVersion(groupId, artifactId);
087         VERSIONS.put(key, v);
088      }
089      return v;
090   }
091
092   /**
093    * Resolves an asset id to its file path under {@code META-INF/resources/webjars/}, checking that the file exists.
094    *
095    * @param asset The asset id (see {@link #asset(String, String, String)}).
096    * @return The path with {@link #VERSION_TOKEN} filled in.
097    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the asset id is malformed.
098    * @throws IllegalStateException If the WebJar or the file isn't on the classpath.
099    */
100   public static String resolvePath(String asset) {
101      var a = parse(asset);
102      var version = version(a[0], a[1]);
103      var path = a[2].replace(VERSION_TOKEN, version);
104      if (! b(PRESENT.computeIfAbsent(path, k -> LOADER.getResource(WEBJARS_ROOT + k) != null)))
105         throw new IllegalStateException(String.format("needs WebJar file '%s' (%s:%s:%s), which is not on the classpath.", path, a[0], a[1], version));
106      return path;
107   }
108
109   /**
110    * Resolves an asset id to an absolute, cache-busted URL under the {@link WebJarsMixin} mount of the request's servlet.
111    *
112    * @param req The in-flight request.
113    * @param asset The asset id (see {@link #asset(String, String, String)}).
114    * @return The URL.
115    */
116   public static String resolve(RestRequest req, String asset) {
117      var a = parse(asset);
118      var path = resolvePath(asset);
119      return req.getUriResolver().resolve("servlet:" + WebJarsMixin.PATH + "/" + path) + "?v=" + version(a[0], a[1]);
120   }
121
122   private static String readVersion(String groupId, String artifactId) {
123      var props = "META-INF/maven/" + groupId + "/" + artifactId + "/pom.properties";
124      try (var in = LOADER.getResourceAsStream(props)) {
125         if (in == null)
126            throw new IllegalStateException(String.format("needs %s:%s on the classpath (no %s).", groupId, artifactId, props));
127         var p = new Properties();
128         p.load(in);
129         var v = p.getProperty("version", "").trim();
130         if (v.isEmpty())
131            throw new IllegalStateException(String.format("needs %s:%s on the classpath (%s has no version).", groupId, artifactId, props));
132         return v;
133      } catch (IOException e) {
134         throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
135      }
136   }
137
138   private static String[] parse(String asset) {
139      var a = asset == null ? new String[0] : asset.split(":", 3);
140      if (a.length != 3 || a[0].isBlank() || a[1].isBlank() || a[2].isBlank())
141         throw new IllegalArgumentException(String.format("WebJar asset must be 'groupId:artifactId:path'; got '%s'.", asset));
142      return a;
143   }
144}
